results.title: Datastory: Turn the world's data into stories worth sharing | Product Hunt
results.content:
Hi Product Hunt! Daniel here, founder of Datastory.  
  
I've spent my career making data understandable and useful: from animating Hans Rosling's TED Talks at Gapminder to building data platforms for the Red Cross, the UN Statistics Division, Brookings and Sweden's national health registries.  
  
Every project showed me the same thing: organizations were building similar platforms from scratch, at great cost. Communicating data well was still slow, expensive, expert work.  
  
We started Datastory as a non-profit, publishing data journalism and building our own tools because nothing else was fast enough. Over time the tools became the product, now used by public agencies, researchers and newsrooms. [...] Bring your own data or use our curated open data catalog, and publish interactive charts that you can embed anywhere. AI drafts, you refine. No code needed.   
  
The free plan allows testing the full range of features. Try it and tell us what's missing. We'll be here all day.  
  
PS: We’re rolling out more templates and open datasets weekly.  
Follow us on LinkedInfor more opportunities. [...] Completed improvements will appear here.
